points.reason: Reset, enable, write-enable and input data can clear or overwrite authenticated_q and a stopped clock can stall its update, threatening integrity and availability; the unchecked write path also permits an authentication-bypass behavior, while this internal block does not itself expose the value.
valid_o is driven directly from authenticated_q, exposing the authorization state; this assignment contains no mechanism that independently modifies or blocks the state.
we_i selects the write that changes authenticated_q, and withholding it prevents the authentication value from being established; the command is not exposed and has no separate special behavior.
enable_i selects the clear assignment for authenticated_q, so changing it alters the authentication behavior and driving it low prevents the authenticated state from remaining available.
